## Nvidia and AMD Lead Broad AI Chip Selloff on Hyperscaler Spending Fears

A sentiment-driven selloff in NVDA and AMD on hyperscaler capex fears is the highest-consequence signal in today's tape for an AI-infrastructure thesis; it indicates the market is pre-emptively pricing downside risk to AI spending ahead of mega-cap earnings this week, and the cluster of simultaneous declines (see 0a2d7b0c2824e5a9, 3b2dca553d3120bc) confirms this is sector-wide, not idiosyncratic.

- AI chip stocks fell broadly with NVDA and AMD as the headline decliners, per GuruFocus.
- The catalyst is framed explicitly as fears about the sustainability of hyperscaler capital spending.
- The selloff has cross-asset implications given the concentration of AI names in major technology indices.
- No specific magnitude of decline is provided in the headline beyond identification of NVDA and AMD as leaders.
